1.title: Game crashes on launch after the latest update
1.body:
Since the last patch the game closes right after the logo screen.
I already restarted my PC. Any other fixes?
1.author: safe_user

answers.author: pixel_pete
answers.body:
Verify the integrity of the game files from the game's Properties window, then restart the client.
That fixed the same crash for me.

answers.author: modder99
answers.body: Update your graphics driver as well. The patch raised the minimum driver version.

3.title: Can I get a refund for a game I played for 3 hours?
3.body: I bought a game last week and played about 3 hours. Is a refund still possible?
3.author: gabe_fan

answers.author: saigon_gamer
answers.body: Usually the limit is 2 hours of playtime, but you can still submit a request and explain the reason.
